faq.q: What artistic effects can it apply?
faq.a: Ten effects: Pencil Sketch, Coloured Pencil, Charcoal, Pen & Ink, Cross-Hatch, Stipple/Dotted, Watercolour, Oil Painting, Cartoon/Comic and Blueprint. Each is real pixel-level processing (edge detection, dodge-blend, posterising, Sobel outlines), not a filter overlay. Four one-click presets — Portrait Sketch, Bold Ink, Soft Watercolour and Comic Pop — set the effect and sliders together.

faq.q: What can I adjust, and can I see the effect against the original?
faq.a: Sliders for line strength/edge threshold, blur radius (0–12), detail level (1–10), contrast and brightness (−50 to 50), plus an Invert toggle. You can choose a white, cream/paper or transparent-PNG background and add paper grain. A draggable split slider shows the original on the left and the effect on the right so you can compare directly as you tweak.

faq.q: Can I process several photos at once?
faq.a: Yes. Drop multiple images and navigate between them with Prev/Next; your current settings apply to the one shown. "Download all as ZIP" processes every image with the same effect and bundles them, showing a progress bar. There's a file-size guard (up to 60 MB) on upload.

Save as PNG, JPEG or WEBP, with a quality slider (10–100%) for the lossy formats. A "High-resolution export" checkbox processes at the full image size rather than the ~900px preview, and an approximate file-size readout updates as you change settings. All processing happens in your browser — images are never uploaded.
